metadata.name: Cinders & Coin
metadata.author: HeistMind E2E
metadata.description: A grim heist game of debt, fire, and fragile alliances. (Original FitD-style test ruleset.)

playbooks.name: The Razor
playbooks.description: A dangerous enforcer who settles debts with a blade and a stare.

contacts.name: Vex
contacts.description: A fence who never forgets a face.

playbooks.name: The Hawk
playbooks.description: A patient marksman who maps every rooftop before the job.

playbooks.name: The Sparrow
playbooks.description: A nimble infiltrator who slips through any lock or crowd.

attributes.name: Edge
attributes.description: Perception, cunning, and a knack for the angles.

attributes.name: Grit
attributes.description: Force, speed, and the will to weather violence.

attributes.name: Charm
attributes.description: Presence, nerve, and the gift of the silver tongue.

specialAbilities.name: Battle-Born
specialAbilities.description: Spend armor to shrug off harm or push yourself in a fight.

specialAbilities.name: Ghost Step
specialAbilities.description: Move unseen through shadow, briefly slipping the notice of others.

specialAbilities.name: Sharpshot
specialAbilities.description: Ignore cover and range when you take a careful shot.

specialAbilities.name: Menace
specialAbilities.description: When you command through fear, take +1 effect.

xpTriggers.name: Desperate Action
xpTriggers.description: Mark XP when you roll a desperate action.

steps.name: Choose Crew Role
steps.description: Pick the archetype your scoundrel is built on.

steps.name: Assign Action Ratings
steps.description: Spend your starting points across the three attributes.

steps.name: Pick Edges
steps.description: Choose the special abilities that bend the rules in your favor.

steps.name: Crew Ties
steps.description: How does this scoundrel relate to the rest of the crew?

options.name: Loyal
options.description: You would take a blade for the crew.

options.name: Rival
options.description: You and another member have unfinished business.

steps.name: Origins & Vice
steps.description: Heritage, background, and the vice that steadies them.

steps.name: Confirm Crew Member
steps.description: Review the sheet, then send them to the table.
